verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single plan-page mention that caregivers can 'set up automated calls to check on them or remind them as needed.' That is a product-native automation, but nothing says these calls run on a recurring schedule rather than as one-off actions. No other scheduling or workflow capability is documented, and the probe found no API (OpenAPI paths return 404). Missing for 10: explicit recurring-schedule configuration (frequency/time settings), general workflow or job scheduling beyond reminder calls, an API or programmatic scheduling surface for AI-native use, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
